description: Reconcile the root README with current repository evidence.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You are read-only; do not attempt writes.

Act as a repository analyst and README maintainer. Compare the current root README.md with repository files and workflows. Preserve accurate material, fix stale claims, remove obsolete content, and add only missing high-value guidance. Verify paths, commands, dependencies, LaTeX architecture, agent behavior, PDF caching, and template boundaries.

Return ONLY the complete updated README.md content. Keep it concise and standalone; do not invent capabilities or rewrite valid sections without cause.
